lines.text: Hello, dear child. My name is Juejue, and I’m the Hugging Frog from the Mirror World. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
How can I help you?
Hello, Juejue. I have been feeling unhappy lately, but I can’t quite put my finger on why.
Have you ever really asked yourself what’s going on with you?
It feels like I’m always taking care of others, but I don’t know what I want for myself.
Well, today, let’s not rush to solve the problem just yet. Would you be willing to listen to your own heart?
I’d love to.
Let me think for a moment—what am I truly feeling right now?
My dear child, I see your exhaustion, and I see your hurt. Are you okay now?
Yes. I think I need to allow myself to feel my true emotions and be willing to listen to myself.
Hello, dear child. My name is Xingqingqing, and I’m an emotion fairy. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
How have you been feeling lately?
Hi, Xinquingqing. I don’t like it when I feel angry, sad, or anxious.
Why?
Because I feel like these emotions mean I’m not good enough.
What if emotions aren’t a mistake, but are actually telling you something?
Like what?
Anger might be reminding you that your boundaries have been crossed, and sadness might be telling you that you’ve lost something important.
So emotions actually have their own meaning.
Yes, every emotion deserves to be understood.
Mm-hmm, I want to understand my emotions instead of suppressing them.
Hello, dear child. My name is Youyou. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Youyou. I’m always afraid that others won’t like me.
What would you do if others weren’t satisfied?
I’d feel like I’d done something wrong.
Have you been used to being an obedient, sensible person who pleases others since you were little?
Yes, I always hope others will approve of me.
Then today, would you be willing to ask yourself: What do I truly want?
I’m willing.
I think I don’t have to prove my worth by pleasing others.
I have the right to be my true self.
Hello, dear child. My name is Chuchu. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Chuchu. I’m always afraid of making mistakes when I do things.
What does making a mistake mean to you?
It means being criticized and not being liked.
When you made mistakes as a child, did you receive understanding or blame?
More often than not, it was blame.
Do you need to be perfect first in order to be loved?
It seems like that’s what I’ve always believed.
You’re all grown up now, and you can learn to treat yourself differently.
Yeah, I don’t need to grow up by punishing myself anymore.
Even when I make mistakes, I’m still worthy of love.
Yes, you don’t need to prove your worth. You’re born worthy of love—you don’t need to prove it to anyone.
Yes, I’m worthy of love just as I am.
Allow yourself to be imperfect, and allow yourself to grow.
Hello, dear child. My name is Mianmian. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hi, Mianmian. Why is it that sometimes just one thing someone says can make me feel really sad?
Maybe that comment touched on some past pain you’ve experienced.
What should I do?
Try to look at that part of yourself that was once hurt.
Hmm, I think I want to give my younger self a hug.
Yes, you can tell him that you’ve grown up now and that you’ll protect yourself.
I want to be my own supporter and protector.
Hello, dear child. My name is Shanshan. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Shanshan. I’m always hoping others will praise me.
If no one praises you, do you feel like you’re not good enough?
I guess so.
So, have you been letting others decide your worth all along?
Yes.
Now, are you willing to take back the right to evaluate yourself?
I am. I want to learn to appreciate myself.
(I list three things about myself that are worth appreciating.) My worth doesn’t need to be determined by others.
Hello, dear child. My name is Yuanyuan. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Yuanyuan. I’ve realized I have a lot of flaws.
Have you noticed any of your strengths?
I don’t seem to pay much attention to them.
You don’t have to love only the “perfect” version of yourself.
So can I also love the vulnerable, sensitive, and imperfect parts of myself?
Of course.
Hmm, starting today, I’m willing to accept myself completely.
No matter what I’m like, I deserve to be loved.
Hello, dear child. My name is Yu Xinxin. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Yu Xinxin. I always regret the things I’ve done in the past.
At the time, did you do the best you could?
Yes, but looking back now, it seems very immature.
You can learn from the past, but you don’t have to punish your past self forever.
Hmm, I’m willing to forgive myself. I forgive my past self and allow myself to start over.
Hello, dear child. My name is Hehe. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Hehe. I always feel like I should be the person others expect me to be.
So, what kind of life do you expect for yourself?
I don’t think I’ve ever really thought about it seriously.
Does your life really have to be played out according to someone else’s script?
No, I want to make my own choices.
If you didn’t need anyone’s approval, what kind of life would you most want to live?
I think I have the right to write my own life story.
Hello, dear child. My name is Xiao Li. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Xiao Li. I’m always afraid to say no to others.
Every time you agree to something, are you truly willing to do it deep down?
Most of the time, I don’t really want to.
Then why don’t you say no?
I’m afraid of disappointing others.
Just because others are disappointed does not mean you have done anything wrong.
Hmm, I can be kind and still have my own boundaries.
Saying no to unreasonable requests does not mean I’m not kind enough. I need to respect my own needs and boundaries.
Hello, dear child. My name is Qingqing. Through our conversation, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Qingqing. There are some hurts that I have kept locked away in my heart.
Hmm, so do you want the past to keep affecting your present?
No, but it’s really hard for me to let go.
You can acknowledge that you have been hurt, and you can slowly regain your strength.
Hmm, I don’t have to keep punishing myself for other people’s actions.
“I acknowledge my pain, and I allow myself to let go little by little.”
I will no longer let the past determine my future.
Hello, dear child. My name is Ling. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Ling. I always feel like I’m not trying hard enough.
Do you often blame yourself in your heart?
Yes, I’m afraid that if I let up even a little, I’ll become lazy.
What if growth could come from encouragement rather than scolding?
Oh, so I can be gentle with myself.
(When criticism arises in my mind, I’ll replace it with a word of encouragement. I’ll use understanding and encouragement instead of harsh criticism.)
Hello, dear child. My name is Anhe. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Anhe. I’m always hoping someone will understand me and take care of me.
Have you ever truly taken care of yourself?
It seems like I always neglect myself.
You can expect others to give you love, but you can also take the initiative to care for yourself.
I’m willing to start by learning to take care of my own feelings.
What small, heartwarming thing can you do for yourself today?
Hmm, I think I deserve to be cared for, and I’m capable of taking care of myself.
Hello, dear child. My name is Xinyu. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Xinyu. Why does my life never go the way I want it to?
Do you feel like you have absolutely no choice in your life?
Sometimes I feel powerless.
You may not have been able to choose what happened in the past, but you can gradually learn to choose how to respond in the present.
Hmm, I’m no longer just waiting for others to change; I’m also willing to take responsibility for my own life.
Let me think—what’s one thing today that I can actively change? I have the power to make new choices for my life.
Hello, dear child. My name is MuMu. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, MuMu. Why do I always worry that others don’t love me?
Do you view others’ love as proof of your own worth?
Yes. I’m afraid of getting hurt.
Truly healthy love does not require you to lose yourself.
You can stay true to yourself within love, and you can build trust gradually.
Hmm, I’m willing to love others without forgetting to love myself.
Hello, dear child. My name is Yingying. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Yingying. I always feel like I’m not living in abundance.
Have you noticed what you already have?
I seem to always focus on what’s missing.
You can re-examine these limiting beliefs.
Hmm, I’m willing to see every bit of abundance in my life.
Hello, dear child. My name is Yueyue. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Yueyue. There are so many things I want to do, but I’m always afraid of failing.
Do you expect yourself to succeed right from the start?
Yes.
You can allow yourself to go from not knowing to knowing, from unfamiliarity to familiarity.
Hmm, I’m willing to take the first step.
(I believe in my abilities, and I believe in my growth.)
Hello, dear child. My name is Qing Tuantuan. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Qing Tuantuan. I always feel like I should not be too happy.
Why?
It seems like whenever I’m happy, something bad always happens afterward.
You don’t need to refuse to have something just because you’re afraid of losing it.
Hmm, I’m willing to enjoy the moment with peace of mind.
(Allowing myself to be happy, without feeling guilty for being happy)
Hello, dear child. My name is Flow. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Flow. Change makes me feel very uneasy.
Are you afraid of losing everything familiar?
Yes.
But if you stay stuck in the same place, you might never discover a new version of yourself.
Hmm, I’m willing to take a small step forward with a little courage. I’ll let new possibilities into my life.
(Change can be safe; I have the ability to adapt to a new life.)
Hello, dear child. My name is Kui Kui. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Kui Kui. I used to always hope someone would come to save me.
And what about now?
I’ve realized that I can be my own source of support.
Hmm. When you’re feeling down, how do you treat yourself?
I listen to myself, comfort myself, and no longer dismiss myself so easily.
Hmm, your most reliable friend.
I’m willing to be there for myself for the rest of my life.
Hello, dear child. My name is Xi Xi. Through our conversations, I’ll help you find some guidance in the Mirror World.
Hello, Xi Xi. This is my 21st day in the Mirror World. What do you think has been my biggest change?
You’ve started to recognize your emotions, understand your past, and learn to take responsibility for your choices.
I’m no longer so dependent on other people’s opinions.
So, are you still willing to continue loving yourself?
I am.
Even if you have flaws, make mistakes, or feel vulnerable from time to time?
Yes. Because I have finally realized that loving myself is not about demanding that I be perfect all the time, but about not giving up on myself even when I’m imperfect.
Welcome back to being the master of your own life.
